messages:
maya: Quick weekly check-in for VeraCommerce — caching + batching health. TL;DR: hit rate down 48% -> 36% w/w, avg batch size 2.7 -> 1.9, cost per 1k tokens up ~14%. @derek @jonah @tara can you confirm causes and proposed mitigations? :thinking:

metrics-bot: Snapshot (2026-03-11 -> 2026-03-18):
- total requests: 1.1M -> 1.25M
- cache hit rate: 48% -> 36%
- avg batch size: 2.7 -> 1.9
- p95 latency: 210ms -> 490ms
- errors (4xx/5xx rate): 0.12% -> 0.9%
- cost per 1k tokens: $7.80 -> $8.91
(links: https://console.redwood/v/vera/metrics) :bar_chart:

derek: I saw a config change on 2026-03-15 that reduced prefetch.window_seconds from 60 -> 10 in the cohort selector. That will reduce prefix caching effectiveness and increase first-token misses. Snippet from deploy logs:
```
service.prefetch:{
  cohort: "v2_onboarded_users",
  prefetch.window_seconds: 10
}
```
I can roll that back to 60 for a canary if we want to test impact.

jonah: Correlating traces: the biggest latency and error spikes align with the config change and also with a drop in batch size during peak hours. p95 jumps when batch_size <= 2 and cache miss. Repro trace example: request id r-9f3a -> 480ms (cache miss, small batch). Also saw a small uptick in transient 5xx from our batching layer when queue time < 5ms.

tara: This directly affects VeraCommerce's spend forecast and the renewal conversation next month. Recommend: 1) Canary revert prefetch.window_seconds to 60 for 5% traffic; 2) tune batching policy to increase max wait to 15ms for small request types; 3) prepare a short customer note explaining we're optimizing to reduce their token spend and latency. I'll draft the message once we confirm numbers. :memo:

maya: Action list: derek -> run canary revert (5% traffic) tomorrow 10:00 PT; jonah -> add alert for batch_size < 2.0 and cache_hit_rate < 40%; tara -> draft customer-facing note and share here for sign-off. I'll book a 20-min sync after canary results. :calendar:

derek: I'll take the canary. Will push revert at 10:00 PT and instrument metrics: `batch_size_dist`, `cache_hit_rate_by_cohort`, `latency_p95_by_cohort`. Posting canary results here ~10:25 PT. :thumbsup:

jonah: I'll create alert rules and a temporary dashboard slice for this cohort. Setting pager thresholds to p95 > 400ms or errors > 0.5% during the test window. Will also keep an eye on the batching layer 5xx. :eyes:

ops-bot: Canary scheduled by derek for 1912013600 (2026-03-19 10:00 PT). Channel alerting enabled.

maya: Thanks team — priority is to show VeraCommerce a measurable drop in cost-per-1k and p95 within 48hrs. Please post canary numbers and customer note draft in this thread.
